summary: This is a Mol Labs public report (P27) framing a research hypothesis ("assumption-kill") about whether NPY or [Leu31,Pro34]NPY retains neuroprotective or cognitive phenotype (≥50% of the NPY/[Leu31,Pro34]NPY without-Y1-abolish arm) under conditions where Y1-class attribution is abolished via BIBP3226 or Npy1r/Y1 genetic LOF. The document synthesizes existing literature (Flood, Decressac, Fendt, Bertocchi, Xapelli, Rudolf, Pedrazzini) to establish that the key matched residual H2H experiment on Flood-memory or Decressac-PD panels is UNKNOWN and not yet run. The project is at TRL 1–2: the concept is defined, prior art is mapped, and an assay proposal is outlined, but no new experimental data are presented.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis Statement (P27)
content_blocks.content: On a matched rodent cognition/neuroprotection panel (Flood/Decressac-class, or Fendt/Bertocchi/Xapelli-class style) ± NPY (or [Leu31,Pro34]NPY) ± Y1 antagonist (BIBP3226 or equivalent) or Npy1r/Y1 genetic LOF titrated to abolish Y1-class neuroprotection/cognition attribution: under that Y1-abolish condition, residual NPY (or [Leu31,Pro34]NPY) neuroprotective/cognitive phenotype remains ≥50% of the NPY/[Leu31,Pro34]NPY without-Y1-abolish arm on the same panel. This is framed as an 'assumption-kill / y1-insufficiency' hypothesis. The claim is a PREDICTION; no new experimental data are presented.

content_blocks.title: Why It Matters / Scientific Rationale
content_blocks.content: Flood/Decressac map NPY T-maze/passive-avoidance memory and PD neuroprotection phenotypes. Fendt maps Y1-independent residual NPY fear reduction under BIBO3304/Y1R LOF. Bertocchi/Xapelli map Y1 necessity for spatial learning and Y1-agonist kainate neuroprotection. P27 asks whether residual NPY (or [Leu31,Pro34]NPY) neuroprotection/cognition under a Y1 antagonist or Npy1r/Y1 LOF that abolishes Y1-class attribution still requires a path beyond Y1-class attribution — the 'y1-insufficiency assumption-kill.' Explicitly distinct from P15–P26 (BPC/FBXO22, LKKTETQ, MOTS-c, SS-31, ARA290, Semax, Selank, Dihexa, oxytocin, Exendin-4, ghrelin, PACAP).

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch / Literature Synthesis
content_blocks.content:
Key literature positions:
1. Flood (PMID 3690274): i.c.v. NPY enhances T-maze footshock-avoidance and step-down passive-avoidance retention (inverted-U); alleviates anisomycin/scopolamine amnesia — cognition phenotype PRIOR; NO BIBP3226/Npy1r LOF residual arm.
2. Decressac (PMID 21816512): NPY neuroprotection in SH-SY5Y 6-OHDA and rat/mouse PD models; no NP under Y2 antagonist or in Y2-deficient mice (Y2-mediated necessity) — NP phenotype PRIOR + Y2 necessity; NOT Y1-abolish residual H2H; do not invent Y1 residual from Y2 mediation.
3. Fendt (PMID 19609506): Intra-amygdala NPY fear-reducing effects retained under BIBO3304 and in Y1R-deficient mice — RESIDUAL-POSITIVE Y1-independent for conditioned-fear panel; caveat: BIBO3304 ≠ BIBP3226; panel = fear ≠ Flood T-maze/Decressac PD.
4. Bertocchi (PMID 33285203): Conditional adult forebrain excitatory-neuron Npy1r depletion slows spatial learning (PNN intensification; CA1 c-Fos); PNN digestion rescues — Y1 NECESSITY AGAINST residual for that cognition panel.
5. Xapelli (PMID 17212973, promoted, out of public prior_art ≤4): BIBP3226 abolishes Y1-activation kainate NP — necessity AGAINST residual for Y1-agonist NP class.
6. Rudolf (PMID 7705422, promoted): BIBP3226 experimental tool (Ki=7 nM) — TOOL prior.
7. Pedrazzini (PMID 9623984): Y1 KO CV/feeding/locomotor — TOOL ≠ cognition/NP residual H2H.
8. Adjacent non-matches: Karlsson (Y1 necessary for NPY anxiolytic), Verma (endogenous Y1+Y2 fear), Chen ([Leu31,Pro34]NPY worsens MCAO while BIBP3226 reduces infarct — opposite direction NON-MATCH).

content_blocks.title: Proposed Assay / Method
content_blocks.content: Method type: propose-assay. Preferred sequence: (1) cell/slice/block-QC with BIBP3226 or Npy1r ablation (Xapelli organotypic/Decressac SH-SY5Y style) to confirm Y1-class attribution is abolished before proceeding to animal studies; (2) in vivo panel (Flood/Decressac-class or Fendt/Bertocchi/Xapelli-class) remains primary kill path. Design: matched rodent cognition/neuroprotection panel ± NPY (or [Leu31,Pro34]NPY) ± Y1 antagonist (BIBP3226 or equivalent) or Npy1r/Y1 genetic LOF; block must first abolish Y1-class neuroprotection/cognition attribution; then score residual NPY/[Leu31,Pro34]NPY neuroprotection/cognition vs NPY/[Leu31,Pro34]NPY without-Y1-abolish arm; α/N pre-specified. No dosing specified. Reviews ≠ experimental anchors.

content_blocks.title: Execution Status, IP, and Cost
content_blocks.content: Execution status: NOT_RUN. FTO status: UNKNOWN. Kill cost tier: 1. Time to refute: 4 weeks. IP class: y1-insufficiency. Vault hold: no. Related prior: Flood i.c.v. NPY T-maze/passive-avoidance (no residual arm); Decressac NPY PD NP Y2-mediated (not Y1 residual H2H); Fendt intra-amygdala NPY fear residual under BIBO3304/Y1R LOF (fear panel); Bertocchi conditional Npy1r LOF spatial-learning necessity AGAINST residual; Xapelli BIBP3226 abolishes Y1-activation kainate NP (promoted necessity); Rudolf BIBP3226 experimental tool (promoted); Pedrazzini Y1 KO CV/feeding/locomotor TOOL; Chen opposite-direction MCAO NON-MATCH.

content_blocks.title: Refute Condition and Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
Refute if: On the pre-registered matched rodent cognition/NP panel ± NPY/[Leu31,Pro34]NPY ± BIBP3226 or Npy1r LOF where Y1-abolish abolishes Y1-class attribution, residual NPY/[Leu31,Pro34]NPY neuroprotective/cognitive phenotype is <50% of the NPY/[Leu31,Pro34]NPY without-Y1-abolish arm — when abolish-fail, agonist-alone-null, underpowered strata, or assay-mismatch artifacts are ruled out.

Key actionable limitations:
1. Do not treat P1–P26 as proving P27; soft-complete empty ≠ demonstrated residual phenotype.
2. Do not collapse to skip-list orthosteric dialect (BPC/FBXO22, LKKTETQ, MOTS-c, SS-31, ARA290, Semax/TrkB, Selank/GABA, Dihexa/c-Met, oxytocin/OXTR, Exendin/GLP1R, ghrelin/GHSR, PACAP/PAC1); NOT FOXO4×LOF.
3. Flood/Decressac lack NPY residual arm under Y1-abolish; do not invent residual when UNKNOWN; do not treat necessity as residual-positive; do not treat Fendt fear residual as Flood/Decressac claim core; do not invent Y1 residual from Decressac Y2 mediation.

key_findings: P27 is a PREDICTION/hypothesis (NOT_RUN): no new experimental data are presented; the matched residual H2H experiment on Flood-memory or Decressac-PD panels is UNKNOWN.

Flood (PMID 3690274): i.c.v. NPY enhances T-maze footshock-avoidance and passive-avoidance retention (inverted-U); alleviates anisomycin/scopolamine amnesia — cognition phenotype PRIOR with NO BIBP3226/Npy1r LOF residual arm.

Decressac (PMID 21816512): NPY neuroprotection in SH-SY5Y 6-OHDA and rat/mouse PD models is Y2-mediated (no NP under Y2 antagonist or in Y2-deficient mice); no Y1-abolish residual H2H; do not invent Y1 residual from Y2 mediation.

Fendt (PMID 19609506): Intra-amygdala NPY fear-reducing effects retained under BIBO3304 and in Y1R-deficient mice — RESIDUAL-POSITIVE Y1-independent for conditioned-fear panel; caveat: BIBO3304 ≠ BIBP3226; panel = fear ≠ Flood T-maze/Decressac PD.

Bertocchi (PMID 33285203): Conditional adult forebrain Npy1r depletion slows spatial learning (PNN intensification; CA1 c-Fos); PNN digestion rescues — Y1 NECESSITY AGAINST residual for spatial learning panel.
Xapelli (PMID 17212973, promoted): BIBP3226 abolishes Y1-activation kainate neuroprotection — necessity AGAINST residual for Y1-agonist NP class.
Rudolf (PMID 7705422, promoted): BIBP3226 experimental tool with Ki=7 nM — TOOL prior only.
Pedrazzini (PMID 9623984): Y1 KO CV/feeding/locomotor — TOOL, not cognition/NP residual.
Chen: [Leu31,Pro34]NPY worsens MCAO while BIBP3226 reduces infarct — opposite-direction NON-MATCH.

Claim threshold: residual NPY/[Leu31,Pro34]NPY neuroprotective/cognitive phenotype ≥50% of NPY/[Leu31,Pro34]NPY without-Y1-abolish arm under Y1-abolish condition; α/N pre-specified; author-chosen PREDICTION.
Execution status: NOT_RUN. Kill cost tier: 1. Time to refute: 4 weeks. FTO status: UNKNOWN.

Preferred assay sequence: cell/slice/block-QC (BIBP3226 or Npy1r ablation; Xapelli organotypic/Decressac SH-SY5Y style) before new animal Flood/Decressac/Fendt/Bertocchi-class cognition/NP panels; in vivo panel remains primary kill path.
Competing inconclusive outcomes pre-registered: abolish-fail, agonist-alone-null, underpowered strata, assay-mismatch (inconclusive ≠ refute).
P15–P26 are explicitly distinct from P27; none of them prove P27; soft-complete empty ≠ novelty/failure.
